question: Which eighteen-syllabled mantra ending with kāma protects in the northwest direction?
premises: The mantra is described as having eighteen syllables.
It ends with the syllable or term kāma.
It is asked to protect the speaker always in the northwest.
inference: The eighteen-syllabled mantra ending in kāma protects in the northwest.
plain_english: May the eighteen-syllabled mantra ending with kāma always protect me in the northwest.
